data.title: An invitation on the other side of the glass
data.goal: Explain why two neighbours cannot join and offer another way.

memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 海报贴在入口玻璃上，米拉拿着手机站在门外；汤姆从邻近的家走来。
memoryNodes.cue: Why has Mira not put her name down?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 米拉为什么还没有报名？

memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 进门后，报名屏幕转向两人；看不懂说明与没有手机分别阻碍他们报名。
memoryNodes.cue: What makes joining difficult for each neighbour?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 两位邻居各因什么难以报名？

memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 纸质名单留在前台屏幕旁，折好的邀请移到窗边，准备带到街坊家中。
memoryNodes.cue: What other way can someone put their name down?

memoryNodes.locationRelationZh: 汤姆把外套搭在椅背上留下来帮忙，米拉在纸质名单上写了名字与带汤的计划。
memoryNodes.cue: What do Mira and Tom offer to do?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 米拉与汤姆分别提出做什么？

data.situation: Mira stopped beneath the supper poster on the community centre's glass door, phone in hand. She had moved from another country to live here permanently; she was a new immigrant, but she was already getting to know the street. Tom, a resident of the house next door, came over with his coat on his arm. “I need time to adapt to life here,” she told him. “I saw the invitation, but I couldn't work out how to put my name down.” Inside, Nora turned the screen at the front desk towards them. The only way to join was an online form. The desk screen showed instructions, but it could not be used to fill in the form. The form opened through a code scanned with a smartphone. Mira could read some of the instructions, but not enough to finish it. Tom had no smartphone. These were barriers to joining the supper. One of the volunteers had thought that the new neighbours were simply not interested. After listening, he said, “We asked people to come, then made it hard to say yes.” The volunteers' attitudes towards the neighbours began to change. Nora took a blank sheet from the drawer and wrote the date, time and place at the top. Below, she left spaces for names and wrote “You can also ask at this desk.” She checked the wording with Mira, then put the paper list beside the screen. For her, inclusion meant making another way in. The online form could stay, but it would no longer be the only door. By the window, Mira folded a small stack of invitations with the same details. Tom offered to take some to the houses along his side of the street. He left his coat over a chair while they worked. Before leaving, Mira added her name to the list and asked whether she could bring soup made from her grandmother's recipe. Nora smiled and wrote “soup” beside it. The empty space had become a plan.
data.easySummary: Mira and Tom want to join a community supper. The online form is difficult for Mira to read, and Tom has no smartphone. Nora adds a paper list. Mira signs up to bring soup, and Tom takes invitations to his neighbours.
data.easySummaryZh: 米拉和汤姆想参加社区晚餐。米拉难以读懂网上表格，汤姆则没有智能手机。诺拉加了一张纸质名单。米拉报名带汤，汤姆为邻居送去邀请。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Mira has moved to this country to live here permanently. Tom lives next door. Introduce them, and explain why the routines here are still new to Mira.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 米拉从另一个国家迁来，打算长期在这里生活。汤姆住在隔壁。介绍这两位邻居，并说明米拉为什么仍不熟悉这里的日常习惯。
acceptableAnswers: Mira is a new immigrant. Tom is a local resident. Mira needs time to adapt to life here.
checks: 长期跨国迁移与某地居民的范围不同
适应后保留to接生活环境

retrievalPrompts.cue: A volunteer thinks that Mira and Tom do not want to come. Explain their different difficulties and why his view should change.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 一位志愿者以为米拉和汤姆不想来。说明两人各自遇到的困难，以及为什么他应该改变看法。
acceptableAnswers: The online instructions and the need for a smartphone are barriers to joining. The volunteers' attitudes towards the neighbours can change after they hear these difficulties.
checks: 分别指出读不懂说明与没有手机
不把困难说成不感兴趣

retrievalPrompts.cue: Nora keeps the online form and adds a paper list with help at the desk. Tell another volunteer what this change means for joining the supper.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 诺拉保留网上表格，增加一张纸质名单，还允许到前台寻求帮助。向另一位志愿者说明这对参加晚餐意味着什么。
acceptableAnswers: This supports inclusion: people can put their names down on paper or ask at the desk, even if the online form does not work for them.
checks: 不说纸质名单强迫每个人参加

transferPrompt.cue: At a neighbourhood repair afternoon, some people cannot use the online booking page. Others do not understand its instructions. A paper list and a person at the desk are available. Explain the difficulties and suggest how people can join.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 在街区的一次维修活动中，有人无法使用网上预约页面，也有人读不懂说明。现场有纸质名单和前台工作人员。说明困难，并建议怎样让人们参加。
acceptableAnswers: The booking page and unclear instructions can be barriers to joining. A paper list and help at the desk support inclusion.
checks: 换用维修活动而非晚餐
